rules.rule: Coverage counts only the unit's own tests run in isolation
must: Coverage a unit picks up from a caller's tests or a\s+parent component's tests does not count
The unit — never the file or the\s+directory — is the unit of work

rules.rule: Coverage thresholds are never lowered; the config is never edited to measure
must: Never lower the project's coverage\s+thresholds
the\s+config is never edited
Never lower a threshold to pass

rules.rule: Finish and verify one unit before the next
must: Never start unit B until unit A's loop is\s+complete and verified

rules.rule: A filter matching no test is an uncovered unit, not a clean one
must: that is an uncovered unit, not a clean one

rules.rule: File, directory, and all targets present a plan and wait before writing
must: Wait\s+for approval, then run steps 3–4 unit by unit

rules.rule: Report numbers come off the finished artifacts
must: Every number is read off the finished artifacts

rules.rule: No target works the units the working diff touches; an empty diff asks
must: diff \(default, no target\) — every unit whose code the working diff changes
An empty diff: say so and ask for a target

rules.rule: Fan-out is automatic by size, announced in the plan; the max= cap is divided among workers
must: Fan-out is automatic: a target spanning several directories with more than\s+~40 files or ~3000 lines
whether the run\s+fans out and why
a directory whose share is 0 gets no worker

rules.rule: Unrecognized tokens are named and defaults run; an empty target resolution asks
must: Read the tokens in any order: a reserved word is a mode or flag, `key=value`\s+is a control, and anything else is the target
say it was not\s+recognized, name the ones that exist, and run with the defaults as if it were absent
A target\s+that resolves to nothing: say so and ask — never guess what to work on

rules.rule: max= is a hard cap on cases, counted per test or test.each row
must: `max=N` — hard cap on cases added

rules.rule: Delegated by web:audit: report gaps, nothing written
must: A run not told so is not delegated, and runs its target kind as usual
No\ plan\ gate,\ no\ test\ written,\ no\ Verify,\ no\ fan-out
